new_page.description: Soleil condos for sale in White Rock: 26 storeys, 178 apartments, built 2023. Live MLS® listings, building facts and strata tips.
new_page.h1: Soleil Condos for Sale, White Rock

faq.a: Soleil at 1588 Johnston Road was built 2023 by RDG, per the MLS® strata building record.

About 8,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenity space: a fitness room and yoga studio, steam room and sauna, a rooftop deck with a hot tub, barbecue kitchen and gas fire pits, a children’s play area, a car wash bay, two study rooms and two guest suites. Three elevators serve the tower.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Live search: Gerry’s 1452096.

Soleil is the tallest building on the City of White Rock’s list of new major developments: 26 storeys and 178 apartments at the top of Johnston Road, built by RDG and finished in 2023, with shops at street level.

blocks.text: About 8,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenity space: a fitness room and yoga studio, steam room and sauna, a rooftop deck with a hot tub, barbecue kitchen and gas fire pits, a children’s play area, a car wash bay, two study rooms and two guest suites. Three elevators serve the tower.

Soleil sits at the north end of White Rock’s Town Centre, near North Bluff Road, so groceries, cafés and services are a short walk. Upper floors facing south look over the Town Centre toward Semiahmoo Bay.
